basis: Kaspa Docs programmability, payload, wallet, and accepted-transaction guides
Open-source app/protocol repositories from Ethereum and adjacent ecosystems
Known PMF and failure patterns from DeFi, prediction markets, wallets, grants, and indexers

candidates.name: Payload receipt invoices
candidates.pmfSignal: Invoices and receipts are a direct payment use case that can work before advanced programmability.
candidates.kaspaBuild: Use transaction payloads and accepted transaction indexing for paid/unpaid invoice state.

candidates.name: Safe-style team custody
candidates.pmfSignal: Team custody and multisig are durable crypto workflows for treasuries and operations.
candidates.kaspaBuild: Treasury vault templates with spend caps, delayed large withdrawals, and recovery roles.

candidates.name: Conditional token prediction markets
candidates.pmfSignal: Outcome-token markets have real usage when liquidity, resolution, and UX are strong.
candidates.kaspaBuild: Start with simulated markets fed by signed attestations and accepted payload receipts.

candidates.name: Augur-style oracle markets
candidates.pmfSignal: Permissionless market creation proved demand for event markets but also exposed UX and resolution complexity.
candidates.kaspaBuild: Use as warning material for attestation markets and portfolio hedge dashboards.

candidates.name: Uniswap-style AMM
candidates.pmfSignal: Constant-product pools proved strong PMF for permissionless token swaps.
candidates.kaspaBuild: Research AMM UX and risk dashboards before claiming native swaps on Kaspa.

candidates.name: Compound-style lending markets
candidates.pmfSignal: Collateralized borrowing and supply yield are durable DeFi primitives.
candidates.kaspaBuild: Build a lending brief and risk model before any settlement prototype.

candidates.name: Aave-style risk-managed lending
candidates.pmfSignal: Deep lending markets show PMF when risk teams, collateral controls, and integrations mature.
candidates.kaspaBuild: Use for DeFi risk-dashboard design, not immediate Kaspa lending claims.

candidates.name: Marketplace escrow flows
candidates.pmfSignal: Conditional release/refund is easy for normal users to understand.
candidates.kaspaBuild: Build Escrow.sil and signed fund/release/refund drafts.

candidates.name: Assurance/public-goods funding
candidates.pmfSignal: Transparent grants and public funding work when milestones, review, and payout rules are explicit.
candidates.kaspaBuild: Batch assurance campaigns with multiple pledge outputs and accepted state.

candidates.name: Access passes and redeemable claims
candidates.pmfSignal: Tickets, memberships, coupons, and passes are simple issuer/user workflows.
candidates.kaspaBuild: KRC/access-pass planner with issuer-backed redemption state and no false native-contract claim.

candidates.name: Auction and intent systems
candidates.pmfSignal: Auctions and intents become useful when bid data is auditable and settlement is clear.
candidates.kaspaBuild: Accepted bid payload indexer first, covenant settlement later.

candidates.name: Portfolio hedge dashboard
candidates.pmfSignal: Users need risk alerts before complex on-chain hedge products.
candidates.kaspaBuild: Simulated hedge dashboard fed by attestation registry and accepted payload receipts.

candidates.name: AI-agent commitment board
candidates.pmfSignal: Agents need machine-readable offers, deposits, completion proofs, and dispute state.
candidates.kaspaBuild: Task commitment artifact plus payload receipt indexer before any payout automation.

candidates.name: Accepted transaction indexers
candidates.pmfSignal: Every app needs reliable accepted state, rollback handling, and explorer-grade links.
candidates.kaspaBuild: Grow current pull-based proof tracker into checkpointed accepted transaction ingestion.

candidates.name: Wallet API send route
candidates.pmfSignal: Payload apps need a wallet route that preserves bytes and user review.
candidates.kaspaBuild: Find or build payload-preserving send route before accepted invoice receipt broadcast.

candidates.name: Based Apps shared-state lane
candidates.pmfSignal: Shared mutable app state needs a different lane than simple payload receipts or isolated covenants.
candidates.kaspaBuild: Keep rich shared-state products in roadmap until official rails are ready.
